rows.en:
Let's see…?

He's tall and slim, handsome, kind and considerate. The one flaw is that he's always busy… But he's a really wonderful person!
I… I see…

Oh?

[HERO2]? What are you doing in a place like this?

Ah… Aki!

Oh, man… Please keep this a secret from [HERO4].
I see… You're getting a present too, [HERO2]?
Something like that.

There's something for everyone… This is for [HERO4]!

And these are for my senpai…

Wow… What if it's a watch!

My wristwatch… broke, you see.

Kotaro…

As long as I can fight alongside you, Takeshi, Hayato, Shiro, Taki… and [HERO2] and [HERO4]… everyone who gathers here, I don't need anything…

Kotaro…

Even if it's not a watch, I'll treasure it. Your present…
Aki!
Quiet…!
Y… yes.
Mr. Sakata…!?
It was a vicious hit-and-run. What a cruel thing to do…
…The culprit?
According to witnesses, it seems it was deliberate.
Deliberate!?
That culprit… I'll get him for sure!! I'll avenge my brother and sister!

Aki… who did this!?

I won't forgive it…! I won't forgive something like this!!
…A…lien…

An alien…?

Aki, hang in there! We're going skiing over New Year's, right? Pull through!

…!?

Aki… Aki!!
Sis!! Siiis!!
Go's heart is raging like a stormy sea… We can win now! Send out Black King!
…Yes, this is Go.
A kaiju has appeared in Tokyo District A! Please hurry to the scene immediately.
Roger…
Damn it… Aki, Mr. Sakata! Uwaaaagh…!!
Gooo!!
Go! You…

…!?

It's Ultraman!
Ultraman… your life is over too!

"I see, now I understand…

You studied my techniques and trained to defeat me, didn't you? But I won't lose!! I swear I'll avenge the Sakata siblings!"
The attack didn't work!? Ultraman's been beaten!
Did he fall into a trap?

"Give me solar energy! Please, give me solar energy!

I can't… fall here!"
Captain, Ultraman is…
Get up! Hang in there, Ultraman!
Ultraman!!

Ultraman… has been buried by our hands, the hands of Alien Nackle!

Ultraman is dead! Hah hah hah…
The assassination plan against Ultraman by the assassin alien, Alien Nackle! Jiro Sakata, who lost his brother and sister at once…
Don't lose, Ultraman! The Land of Ultra… is always with you!!
Defeat the Married Monsters Seagorath and Seamons, and the Cosmic Monster Bemstar!
Defeat the Married Monsters Seagorath and Seamons, and the Typhoon Monster Varicane!
Defeat the Bodyguard Monster Black King…!

His Majesty the Emperor, who reigns in our distant homeland… the Crisis Empire!

Grant me power… to defeat our sworn enemies, the Kamen Riders…
With power like yours, you cannot defeat the Kamen Riders!
What are you saying, Your Majesty…!

You have piled failure upon failure… and even Maribaron has suffered a humiliating defeat!

Do you understand… how angry I am!?
I will atone for my sins… by defeating the Kamen Riders! I beg you, grant me your power.

Silence, Jark!! Your role is over!

With the power of my wrath, I shall tear your body limb from limb!

Your Majesty!

Intercede with His Majesty! Beg His Majesty to spare General Jark's life… Dasmader!!
Uwah…

General Jark! I shall give you one last chance!

As the strongest monster, Jark Midora, you shall strike down the Kamen Riders!
Dasmader…!? Could it be?
Maribaron! Invite Kotaro Minami to our underground fortress in Hell Valley!
Ooh… Is this Crisis's all-out attack at last?
Damn it… We won't let them do as they please any longer!

Kotaro Minami, Kamen Rider BLACK RX!

I am the ruler of the Kaima World and the Emperor of the Crisis Empire!

I recognize you as a hero without equal on Earth, and hereby bestow on you the Crisis Empire's highest title, "Sir"!

Please wait, Your Majesty!

Giving the position of supreme commander to Kotaro, our sworn enemy… I can't believe such words come from Your Majesty!

Even if they are Your Majesty's words, that is one thing I cannot obey!

The supreme commander is General Jark! General Jark will surely dispose of the Kamen Riders, and defeat this Kotaro as well!

To hand over the position of supreme commander to Kotaro at such a time would be throwing away victory… It absolutely must not be!
Jark Midora…?
Jark Midora…?
Dasmader!?

Kotaro Minami… the talks have broken down!

By order of the Crisis Emperor, we begin our invasion of Earth! Die along with your friends! We'll send you all to hell together!

Hah hah hah…
What…!?

Kotaro…!? Where have you been all this time? Ugh…

Our enemy is Crisis's strongest monster, Jark Midora. A terrifying opponent…
He truly is the strongest monster…
Jark Midora…
You're General Jark!?
Bring it on!
Kotaro… here and now, I'll avenge all those you've defeated!
Kotaro, that's Jark Midora!
Kotaro, that's Jark Midora!

General Jark… you were Jark Midora!?

You're the one I'll never forgive! Senpai, leave this one to me!!
All right, Kotaro! We'll be your witnesses. Fight to your heart's content! And defeat him!

uncertain: U15461: Aki describes Go to the watchmaker (U15460 'What sort of person?').
U15467-U15470: casual-variant copies of the Kotaro gift scene (B0192).
U15480: Jiro says 'my brother and sister' (Ken and Aki); Ken appears to be killed in the hit-and-run as well (U15503).
U15495/U15498: Ultraman's inner speech in 『』 rendered in double quotes.
U15505-U15507: monster titles reconstructed from garbled text: 夫獄打獣→夫婦怪獣 'Married Monsters', 抬願打獣→台風怪獣 'Typhoon Monster', 膤闘棒打獣→用心棒怪獣 'Bodyguard Monster' (all titles not in glossary).
U15537/U15538: Lucifard/Vortex speaker variants; same English.

new_names.why: title for Seagorath/Seamons, not in glossary

glyph_suspects.likely: 夫婦怪獣/台風怪獣/全て
